STUDY.title: University Study in Germany (Bachelor / Master)
STUDY.description: Degree studies at state-accredited German universities and colleges

rules.name: Recognized Academic Qualification
rules.description: Applicant must hold or be completing a recognized Bachelor or 12th+qualification from an accredited Indian institution (Anabin H+).
rules.assumption: Indian 3-year or 4-year Bachelor recognition status under Anabin H+ to be confirmed with Educaro consultant.
rules.remediation: Obtain APS India certificate and Anabin university recognition proof.

rules.name: Subject-Consecutive Field of Study
rules.expectedValue: STEM, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related
rules.description: German public universities require consecutive subject alignment with prior bachelor studies.
rules.assumption: Module credit alignment (ECTS) with target German curriculum to be confirmed with Educaro consultant.
rules.remediation: Map Indian syllabus transcript to German ECTS curriculum requirements.

rules.name: Minimum German Language Readiness
rules.description: Minimum CEFR German B1 level recommended for visa interview, university application, and daily living.
rules.assumption: Conditional admission is viable at B1 with Educaro German language preparation in Germany; confirm with consultant.
rules.remediation: Enroll in Educaro Goethe B1/B2 intensive preparation track.

rules.name: English Proficiency
rules.description: English proficiency B2 (IELTS 6.5 or equivalent) required for English-taught Master programs.
rules.assumption: Medium of Instruction (MOI) letter acceptance varies by university; confirm with Educaro consultant.
rules.remediation: Provide IELTS Academic 6.5+ or official college Medium of Instruction certificate.

rules.name: Academic Performance / CGPA
rules.description: Solid academic record meeting German NC (Numerus Clausus) admissions cutoffs.
rules.assumption: German equivalent grade conversion using Modified Bavarian Formula to be confirmed with Educaro consultant.
rules.remediation: Submit official semester marksheets and provisional degree certificate.

BLUE_CARD.title: EU Blue Card & Skilled Worker Immigration
BLUE_CARD.description: Direct employment pathway for qualified Indian professionals in German tech and engineering

rules.name: Recognized Higher Education Degree
rules.expectedValue: Recognized tertiary degree (B.Tech / B.E. / M.Sc / MCA)
rules.description: Applicant must hold a higher education degree comparable to a German university degree.
rules.assumption: ZAB Statement of Comparability or Anabin degree recognition to be confirmed with Educaro consultant.
rules.remediation: Submit degree certificate for ZAB comparability or Anabin database verification.

rules.name: Relevant Professional Experience
rules.description: At least 2 years of verifiable professional experience in a relevant technical or engineering field.
rules.assumption: Experience letters and pay slips must match German skilled worker classification; confirm with consultant.
rules.remediation: Compile stamped experience letters, reliving letters, and recent salary slips.

rules.name: In-Demand Field (MINT / STEM / IT)
rules.expectedValue: Computer Science, Software, IT, Engineering, Mathematics, Data
rules.description: Target field belongs to German shortage occupations (MINT/IT) eligible for lowered salary thresholds.
rules.assumption: Specialist shortage occupations qualify for lower Blue Card threshold (€45,300); confirm with consultant.
rules.remediation: Highlight software architecture and engineering competencies in CV.

rules.name: German Language Basics
rules.description: CEFR A2 German enables smoother relocation, integration, and fast-track PR after 27 months (21 months with B1).
rules.assumption: English-speaking tech positions in Germany do not strictly mandate B1 for visa, but A2 strengthens application; confirm with consultant.
rules.remediation: Complete A2 German certificate before embassy visa appointment.

rules.name: Job Offer / Salary Threshold Viability
rules.expectedValue: Target salary €45,300+ (MINT) or professional IT candidate profile
rules.description: Profile matches German employment criteria with prospective salary meeting statutory EU Blue Card minimums.
rules.assumption: Statutory salary thresholds updated annually by Federal Interior Ministry (BMI); confirm with consultant.
rules.remediation: Target German tech recruiters and Educaro partner placement channels.
